Title: Haqim's Law: Retribution - efect during combat

Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Haqim's Law: Retribution
Put this card in play. During a bleed action, an Banu Haqim you control can discard a combat card to get +1 bleed.

One player claim how him can use efect Haqim's Law: Retribution during combat,so just for cycle,him can discard card during combat. if that posible?

If is answer yes,many action modifier have same key word (During a bleed action) as Haqim's Law: Retribution,so if is answer yes,can we then play also during combat(after block bleed): Confusion, Bonding, Conditioning......and many other increase bleed cards?

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> One player claim how him can use efect Haqim's Law: Retribution during combat,so just for cycle,him can discard card during combat. if that posible?
>
> If is answer yes,many action modifier have same key word (During a bleed action) as Haqim's Law: Retribution,so if is answer yes,can we then play also during combat(after block bleed): Confusion, Bonding, Conditioning......and many other increase bleed cards?
>
No, it is not possible.
One cannot use a bleed modifier during a non-bleed action/step....combat is not a bleed action/step and HLR is only useable During a bleed action as a modifier effect.

Here groups.google.com/d/msg/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/iRQcAXMl7aY/YMhwNvcDs5QJ is a ruling (on Bonding) that makes it clear that one cannot use a bleed modifier effect on a non-bleed action

Haqim's Law: Retribution

Cardtype: Master
Clan: Banu Haqim
Put this card in play. During a bleed action, a Banu Haqim you control can discard a combat card to get +1 bleed.

This ruling does not apply directly: it’s saying a non-acting minion cannot use retribution.

If the minion is bleeding and gets blocked, he’s acting, so it’s another case.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
There's an old ruling about Pentex(TM) Loves You that clarifies when it can be used, that is: anytime you could you an action modifier.
groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/QujjxfQHYzw/m/S4tNTm4gpi8J

Based on this, I'm issuing a REVERSAL of my  previous answer : you cannot use Banu Haqim: Retribution during combat. You can use it only before action resolution since it is modifying the bleed amount.

(The same applies to Anu Diptinatpa.)

Note that even if one could increase the bleed amount after bleed resolution, this would have no impact on the now-resolved bleed, the same way that making one's hand strikes aggravated after resolution of the strikes doesn't make them retroactively aggravated.
